import fitz

input_path = "./1.pdf"
output_path = "./output.pdf"

replacements = [
    ("6100 Kiskunfélegyháza , Szőlő u 10/3/a", "7800 Siklós Perényi köz 3/2"),
    ("KOLLÁR Sándor", "DUKITS Zoltán"),
    ("Kollár Sándor", "Dukits Zoltán"),
    ("Szabó Katalin", "Kővári Judit"),
    ("2003.04.16.", "2001.01.30."),
    ("2003.04.16", "2001.01.30"),
    ("KOLLÁR", "DUKITS"),
    ("Sándor", "Zoltán"),
    ("Kiskunfélegyháza", "Siklós"),
]

document = fitz.open(input_path)

for page in document:
    matched_rects = []
    to_insert = []
    for old_text, new_text in replacements:
        text_instances = page.search_for(old_text)
        for inst in text_instances:
            overlaps = False
            for matched in matched_rects:
                if inst.intersects(matched):
                    overlaps = True
                    break
            if not overlaps:
                page.add_redact_annot(inst, fill=(1, 1, 1))
                matched_rects.append(inst)
                insert_point = fitz.Point(inst.x0, inst.y1 - 2)
                to_insert.append((insert_point, new_text))
    page.apply_redactions()
    for point, text in to_insert:
        page.insert_text(point, text, fontsize=10, fontname="helv", color=(0, 0, 0))

document.save(output_path)
document.close()

```python
import fitz

input_path = "./1.pdf"
output_path = "./output.pdf"

replacements = [
    ("6100 Kiskunfélegyháza , Szőlő u 10/3/a", "7800 Siklós Perényi köz 3/2"),
    ("Kiskunfélegyháza szolo utca 10", "7800 Siklós Perényi köz 3/2"),
    ("Kiskunfélegyháza Szőlő utca 10", "7800 Siklós Perényi köz 3/2"),
    ("KOLLÁR Sándor", "DUKITS Zoltán"),
    ("Kollár Sándor", "Dukits Zoltán"),
    ("Kollár", "Dukits"),
    ("Sándor", "Zoltán"),
    ("Szabó Katalin", "Kővári Judit"),
    ("Szabó Katalint", "Kővári Judit"),
    ("2003.04.16 Kiskunfélegyházat", "2001.01.30 Siklósra"),
    ("2003.04.16. Kiskunfélegyháza", "2001.01.30. Siklós"),
    ("2003.04.16 Kiskunfélegyháza", "2001.01.30 Siklós"),
    ("2003.04.16.", "2001.01.30."),
    ("2003.04.16", "2001.01.30"),
    ("KOLLÁR", "DUKITS"),
    ("Kiskunfélegyháza", "Siklós"),
]


def get_span_style(page, rect):
    text_dict = page.get_text("dict", clip=rect)
    blocks = text_dict.get("blocks", [])
    for block in blocks:
        for line in block.get("lines", []):
            for span in line.get("spans", []):
                fontname = span.get("font", "helv")
                fontsize = span.get("size", 10)
                color = span.get("color", (0, 0, 0))
                return fontname, fontsize, color
    return "helv", 10, (0, 0, 0)


document = fitz.open(input_path)

for page in document:
    matched_rects = []
    to_insert = []
    for old_text, new_text in replacements:
        text_instances = page.search_for(old_text)
        for inst in text_instances:
            overlaps = False
            for matched in matched_rects:
                if inst.intersects(matched):
                    overlaps = True
                    break
            if not overlaps:
                fontname, fontsize, color = get_span_style(page, inst)
                page.add_redact_annot(inst, fill=(1, 1, 1))
                matched_rects.append(inst)
                insert_point = fitz.Point(inst.x0, inst.y1 - 2)
                to_insert.append((insert_point, new_text, fontname, fontsize, color))
    page.apply_redactions()
    for point, text, fontname, fontsize, color in to_insert:
        page.insert_text(point, text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname, color=color)

document.save(output_path)
document.close()
```
